account: On 14 January 2025 the Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) reported on ALICE (Analisador de Licitações, Contratos e Editais). ALICE, its in-house tool, reads procurement documents with artificial-intelligence techniques and issues risk alerts. It had flagged three 2024 tenders of federal hospitals in Rio de Janeiro state. At the Hospital Federal de Ipanema, tender 90016/2024 for laminated gowns (estimated R$16,726,635.12) was suspended after auditors confirmed an overpricing risk of R$10,925,029.92. Tender 90017/2024 for nursing supplies (estimated R$15,450,714.80) had an overpricing risk of R$5,994,645.60. It was re-estimated at R$12,386,939.96, a saving of R$3,063,774.84. At the Hospital Federal dos Servidores do Estado, tender 90002/2024 (estimated R$26,578,591.02) was revoked after a confirmed risk of R$2,475,054.36. The release gives no total. The three confirmed risks sum to R$19,394,729.88, the R$19.4 million of the headline and metric. The release gives no dates for the suspension and revocation.

ai_role.statement: The CGU release states that each tender “teve alerta do Robô ALICE” and that auditors then confirmed the overpricing risk. The suspension, revocation and re-estimation are described as results of that audit action. Human auditors and hospital managers made the decisions. ALICE's role was detection and triage. Developer and deployer are the same public body, so this is the body documenting its own tool. The CGU page is on record as an archived copy, because the live page was restricted during Brazil's 2026 electoral period.

fields.account: On 14 January 2025 the Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) reported on ALICE (Analisador de Licitações, Contratos e Editais). ALICE, its in-house tool, reads procurement documents with artificial-intelligence techniques and issues risk alerts. It had flagged three 2024 tenders of federal hospitals in Rio de Janeiro state. At the Hospital Federal de Ipanema, tender 90016/2024 for laminated gowns (estimated R$16,726,635.12) was suspended after auditors confirmed an overpricing risk of R$10,925,029.92. Tender 90017/2024 for nursing supplies (estimated R$15,450,714.80) had an overpricing risk of R$5,994,645.60. It was re-estimated at R$12,386,939.96, a saving of R$3,063,774.84. At the Hospital Federal dos Servidores do Estado, tender 90002/2024 (estimated R$26,578,591.02) was revoked after a confirmed risk of R$2,475,054.36. The release gives no total. The three confirmed risks sum to R$19,394,729.88, the R$19.4 million of the headline and metric. The release gives no dates for the suspension and revocation.

fields.account: On 14 January 2025 the Controladoria-Geral da União (CGU) reported on ALICE (Analisador de Licitações, Contratos e Editais). ALICE, its in-house tool, reads procurement documents with artificial-intelligence techniques and issues risk alerts. It had flagged three 2024 tenders of federal hospitals in Rio de Janeiro state. At the Hospital Federal de Ipanema, tender 90016/2024 for laminated gowns (estimated R$16,726,635.12) was suspended after auditors confirmed an overpricing risk of R$10,925,029.92. Tender 90017/2024 for nursing supplies (estimated R$15,450,714.80) had an overpricing risk of R$5,994,645.60. It was re-estimated at R$12,386,939.96, a saving of R$3,063,774.84. At the Hospital Federal dos Servidores do Estado, tender 90002/2024 (estimated R$26,578,591.02) was revoked after a confirmed risk of R$2,475,054.36. The release gives no total. The three confirmed risks sum to R$19,394,729.88, the R$19.4 million of the headline and metric. The release gives no dates for the suspension and revocation.
